-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 4: COMP_MD_COMPFL_STATIC
-- Logic: Comp flag data filtered by @v_week (simulates TBL_WSS_SRP_COMPFLAG populated by procedure)
-- Source: BASE_COMPFL_SOURCE
-- Filters: ZWEEK = @v_week (from STP_WSS_SRP_ATTRIBUTES procedure logic)
-- Note: Represents CV_COMP_MD_COMPFL_STATIC with procedure filter inlined
-- =====================================================================
COMP_MD_COMPFL_STATIC AS (
  SELECT
    MANDT,
    PRCTR,
    STRNUM,
    COMP_VER,
    ZWEEK,
    ZMONTH,
    ZYEAR,
    FS_COMP_PRE,
    RX_COMP_PRE,
    FS_COMP_MON,
    RX_COMP_MON,
    FS_COMP_WK,
    RX_COMP_WK
  FROM
    BASE_COMPFL_SOURCE
  WHERE
    ZWEEK = @v_week
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 5: WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS072
-- Logic: Weekly financial actuals from AZSRP_DS072_VT_S4 with filters
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds212
-- Filters: MANDT IN ('110', '200'), FISCVARNT = 'K4', _BIC_ZIO_VER = @ip_version, 
--          _BIC_ZIO_SWEEK = @ip_week_ly, _BIC_ZIO_SAUDT IN ('1', '10')
-- Aggregation: SUM on _B631_S_AMOUNT and all daily amounts (_BIC_ZIO_D1AMT through _BIC_ZIO_D7AMT)
-- Note: Represents CV_BASE_FIN_WEEKLY_ACTUAL_S4 with column mappings applied
-- =====================================================================
WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS072 AS (
  SELECT
    fiscper AS FISCPER,
    fiscvarnt AS FISCVARNT,
    bic_zio_sweek AS _BIC_ZIO_SWEEK,
    fiscyear AS FISCYEAR,
    fiscper3 AS FISCPER3,
    b631_s_chrtacct AS _B631_S_CHRTACCT,
    b631_s_co_area AS _B631_S_CO_AREA,
    bic_zio_cmpcd AS _BIC_ZIO_CMPCD,
    b631_s_proftctr AS _B631_S_PROFTCTR,
    b631_s_costcntr AS _B631_S_COSTCNTR,
    b631_s_funcarea AS _B631_S_FUNCAREA,
    bic_zio_ver AS _BIC_ZIO_VER,
    bic_zio_saudt AS _BIC_ZIO_SAUDT,
    mandt AS MANDT,
    recordmode AS RECORDMODE,
    b631_s_gl_acct AS _B631_S_GL_ACCT,
    bic_zwwpc_pa1 AS _BIC_ZWWPC_PA1,
    bic_zwwsc_pa1 AS _BIC_ZWWSC_PA1,
    currency AS CURRENCY,
    b631_s_ledger AS _B631_S_LEDGER,
    SUM(b631_s_amount) AS _B631_S_AMOUNT,
    SUM(bic_zio_d1amt) AS _BIC_ZIO_D1AMT,
    SUM(bic_zio_d2amt) AS _BIC_ZIO_D2AMT,
    SUM(bic_zio_d3amt) AS _BIC_ZIO_D3AMT,
    SUM(bic_zio_d4amt) AS _BIC_ZIO_D4AMT,
    SUM(bic_zio_d5amt) AS _BIC_ZIO_D5AMT,
    SUM(bic_zio_d6amt) AS _BIC_ZIO_D6AMT,
    SUM(bic_zio_d7amt) AS _BIC_ZIO_D7AMT
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds212`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('110', '200')
    AND fiscvarnt = 'K4'
    AND bic_zio_ver = @ip_version
    AND bic_zio_sweek = @ip_week_ly
    AND bic_zio_saudt IN ('1', '10')
  GROUP BY
    fiscper, fiscvarnt, bic_zio_sweek, fiscyear, fiscper3, b631_s_chrtacct, b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd, b631_s_proftctr, b631_s_costcntr, b631_s_funcarea, bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt, mandt, recordmode, b631_s_gl_acct, bic_zwwpc_pa1, bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    currency, b631_s_ledger
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 6: PC_HIERARCHY
-- Logic: Profit Center hierarchy nodes filtered for CORE_RET
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node
-- Filters: MANDT IN (120, 200), PARNODE LIKE '%CORE_RET%', HRYVALTO = '99991231'
-- Note: Represents PC_HEIR.CV_BASE_MD_HRRP_NODE_S4 with column mappings applied
-- =====================================================================
PC_HIERARCHY AS (
  SELECT
    mandt AS MANDT,
    parnode AS PARNODE,
    hryvalto AS HRYVALTO,
    nodevalue AS NODEVALUE
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('120', '200')
    AND parnode LIKE '%CORE_RET%'
    AND hryvalto = '99991231'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 7: JOIN_WEEKLY_PC_HIER
-- Logic: Join weekly snapshot with profit center hierarchy
-- Join: INNER JOIN on _B631_S_PROFTCTR = NODEVALUE AND MANDT = MANDT
-- =====================================================================
JOIN_WEEKLY_PC_HIER AS (
  SELECT
    ws.*,
    ph.NODEVALUE AS PC_NODEVALUE
  FROM
    WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS072 ws
    INNER JOIN PC_HIERARCHY ph
      ON ws._B631_S_PROFTCTR = ph.NODEVALUE
      AND ws.MANDT = ph.MANDT
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 8: GL_HIERARCHY
-- Logic: G/L Account hierarchy nodes filtered for node 181 and hierarchy CVS2
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node
-- Filters: MANDT IN (120, 200), PARNODE LIKE '%181', HRYVALTO = '99991231', HRYID = 'CVS2'
-- Calculation: CAL_NODE_VALUE = LTRIM(NODEVALUE, '0')
-- Note: Represents GL_HEIR.CV_BASE_MD_HRRP_NODE_S4 with column mappings applied
-- =====================================================================
GL_HIERARCHY AS (
  SELECT
    mandt AS MANDT,
    parnode AS PARNODE,
    hryvalto AS HRYVALTO,
    nodevalue AS NODEVALUE,
    hryid AS HRYID,
    LTRIM(nodevalue, '0') AS CAL_NODE_VALUE
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('120', '200')
    AND parnode LIKE '%181'
    AND hryvalto = '99991231'
    AND hryid = 'CVS2'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 9: JOIN_GL_HIER
-- Logic: Join with G/L hierarchy
-- Join: INNER JOIN on _B631_S_GL_ACCT = NODEVALUE AND MANDT = MANDT
-- =====================================================================
JOIN_GL_HIER AS (
  SELECT
    j.*,
    gh.NODEVALUE AS GL_NODEVALUE
  FROM
    JOIN_WEEKLY_PC_HIER j
    INNER JOIN GL_HIERARCHY gh
      ON j._B631_S_GL_ACCT = gh.NODEVALUE
      AND j.MANDT = gh.MANDT
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 10: WITH_CAL_WEEK
-- Logic: Add calculated week column from parameter
-- Calculation: CAL_WEEK = @ip_week_cy
-- =====================================================================
WITH_CAL_WEEK AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    @ip_week_cy AS CAL_WEEK
  FROM
    JOIN_GL_HIER
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 11: JOIN_STORE_ATTR
-- Logic: Left join with store attributes
-- Source: COMP_MD_SRPACT_STATIC
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on _B631_S_PROFTCTR = PRCTR AND MANDT = MANDT
-- =====================================================================
JOIN_STORE_ATTR AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    sa.REP_MKT_CODE,
    sa.REP_MKT_DESC,
    sa.EMERG_MKT_IND,
    sa.DIVISION_CODE,
    sa.DIVISION_DESC,
    sa.AREA_CODE,
    sa.AREA_DESC,
    sa.REGION_CODE,
    sa.REGION_DESC,
    sa.DISTRICT_CODE,
    sa.DISTRICT_DESC,
    sa.CITY,
    sa.STATE,
    sa.FS_OPEN_DAT,
    sa.RX_OPEN_DAT,
    sa.STRNUM,
    sa.RX_DIVISION_CODE,
    sa.RX_AREA_CODE,
    sa.RX_REGION_CODE,
    sa.RX_DISTRICT_CODE
  FROM
    WITH_CAL_WEEK p
    LEFT JOIN COMP_MD_SRPACT_STATIC sa
      ON p._B631_S_PROFTCTR = sa.PRCTR
      AND p.MANDT = sa.MANDT
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 12: RETAIL_CALENDAR
-- Logic: Retail calendar week data
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek
-- Filters: RCLNT IN (120, 200)
-- Note: Represents CV_BASE_MD_RCALWEEL_S4 with column mappings applied
-- =====================================================================
RETAIL_CALENDAR AS (
  SELECT
    zrwstrtdate AS ZRWSTRTDATE,
    zrwenddate AS ZRWENDDATE,
    zzweek AS ZZWEEK,
    rclnt AS RCLNT
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek`
  WHERE
    rclnt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 13: JOIN_RETAIL_CAL
-- Logic: Left join with retail calendar
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on CAL_WEEK = ZZWEEK AND MANDT = RCLNT
-- =====================================================================
JOIN_RETAIL_CAL AS (
  SELECT
    j.*,
    rc.ZRWSTRTDATE,
    rc.ZRWENDDATE
  FROM
    JOIN_STORE_ATTR j
    LEFT JOIN RETAIL_CALENDAR rc
      ON j.CAL_WEEK = rc.ZZWEEK
      AND j.MANDT = rc.RCLNT
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 14: JOIN_COMP_FLAG
-- Logic: Left join with comp flag data filtered by @ip_week_cy and @ip_version_comp_flag
-- Source: COMP_MD_COMPFL_STATIC (already filtered by @v_week in CTE 4)
-- Additional Filters: ZWEEK = @ip_week_cy, COMP_VER = @ip_version_comp_flag
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on _B631_S_PROFTCTR = PRCTR AND MANDT = MANDT
-- =====================================================================
JOIN_COMP_FLAG AS (
  SELECT
    wn.*,
    cfl.FS_COMP_WK,
    cfl.RX_COMP_WK,
    cfl.ZWEEK,
    cfl.ZMONTH,
    cfl.ZYEAR,
    cfl.COMP_VER
  FROM
    JOIN_RETAIL_CAL wn
    LEFT JOIN COMP_MD_COMPFL_STATIC cfl
      ON wn._B631_S_PROFTCTR = cfl.PRCTR
      AND wn.MANDT = cfl.MANDT
      AND cfl.ZWEEK = @ip_week_cy
      AND cfl.COMP_VER = @ip_version_comp_flag
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 15: PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Logic: Profit center text descriptions
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct
-- Filters: MANDT IN (120, 200)
-- Note: Represents CV_BASE_MD_CEPCT_S4 with column mappings applied
-- =====================================================================
PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT AS (
  SELECT
    mandt AS MANDT,
    prctr AS PRCTR,
    ltext AS PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 16: JOIN_PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Logic: Left join with profit center text
-- Join: LEFT JOIN on _B631_S_PROFTCTR = PRCTR AND MANDT = MANDT
-- =====================================================================
JOIN_PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT AS (
  SELECT
    jcf.*,
    pct.PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
  FROM
    JOIN_COMP_FLAG jcf
    LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT pct
      ON jcf._B631_S_PROFTCTR = pct.PRCTR
      AND jcf.MANDT = pct.MANDT
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 17: WITH_CALCULATED_FLAGS
-- Logic: Add calculated columns for FS/RX flag, comp flag, and week number
-- Calculation: 
--   - CAL_FS_RX_FLAG: CASE WHEN LEFT(_BIC_ZWWPC_PA1, 2) = 'FS' THEN 'FS' 
--                           WHEN LEFT(_BIC_ZWWPC_PA1, 2) = 'RX' THEN 'RX' ELSE '' END
--   - CAL_COMP_FLAG: CASE WHEN LEFT(_BIC_ZWWPC_PA1, 2) = 'FS' THEN FS_COMP_WK
--                         WHEN LEFT(_BIC_ZWWPC_PA1, 2) = 'RX' THEN RX_COMP_WK 
--                         ELSE FS_COMP_WK END
--   - CAL_WEEK_NUMBER: RIGHT(@ip_week_cy, 2)
-- =====================================================================
WITH_CALCULATED_FLAGS AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN LEFT(_BIC_ZWWPC_PA1, 2) = 'FS' THEN 'FS'
      WHEN LEFT(_BIC_ZWWPC_PA1, 2) = 'RX' THEN 'RX'
      ELSE ''
    END AS CAL_FS_RX_FLAG,
    CASE
      WHEN LEFT(_BIC_ZWWPC_PA1, 2) = 'FS' THEN FS_COMP_WK
      WHEN LEFT(_BIC_ZWWPC_PA1, 2) = 'RX' THEN RX_COMP_WK
      ELSE FS_COMP_WK
    END AS CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    RIGHT(@ip_week_cy, 2) AS CAL_WEEK_NUMBER
  FROM
    JOIN_PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
)

-- =====================================================================
-- FINAL OUTPUT: Aggregated financial actuals with all enrichments
-- Aggregation: GROUP BY all non-measure columns, SUM all measures
-- Calculated Measure: _B631_S_AMOUNT = SUM(_B631_S_AMOUNT) * -1
-- Output Columns: 57 total (as per CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC logical model)
-- =====================================================================
SELECT
  MANDT,
  FISCPER,
  FISCVARNT,
  FISCYEAR,
  FISCPER3,
  _BIC_ZIO_SWEEK,
  _B631_S_CHRTACCT,
  _B631_S_CO_AREA,
  _BIC_ZIO_CMPCD,
  _B631_S_PROFTCTR,
  CAL_FS_RX_FLAG AS FS_RX_FLAG,
  _B631_S_COSTCNTR,
  _B631_S_FUNCAREA,
  _BIC_ZIO_VER,
  _BIC_ZIO_SAUDT,
  _B631_S_GL_ACCT,
  _BIC_ZWWPC_PA1,
  _BIC_ZWWSC_PA1,
  SUM(_B631_S_AMOUNT) * -1 AS _B631_S_AMOUNT,
  SUM(_BIC_ZIO_D1AMT) AS _BIC_ZIO_D1AMT,
  SUM(_BIC_ZIO_D2AMT) AS _BIC_ZIO_D2AMT,
  SUM(_BIC_ZIO_D3AMT) AS _BIC_ZIO_D3AMT,
  SUM(_BIC_ZIO_D4AMT) AS _BIC_ZIO_D4AMT,
  SUM(_BIC_ZIO_D5AMT) AS _BIC_ZIO_D5AMT,
  SUM(_BIC_ZIO_D6AMT) AS _BIC_ZIO_D6AMT,
  SUM(_BIC_ZIO_D7AMT) AS _BIC_ZIO_D7AMT,
  CURRENCY,
  REP_MKT_CODE,
  REP_MKT_DESC,
  EMERG_MKT_IND,
  FS_COMP_WK,
  RX_COMP_WK,
  CAL_COMP_FLAG AS COMP_FLAG,
  DIVISION_CODE,
  DIVISION_DESC,
  AREA_CODE,
  AREA_DESC,
  REGION_CODE,
  REGION_DESC,
  DISTRICT_CODE,
  DISTRICT_DESC,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  ZRWSTRTDATE,
  ZRWENDDATE,
  CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
  PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT,
  FS_OPEN_DAT,
  RX_OPEN_DAT,
  CAL_WEEK,
  STRNUM,
  RX_DIVISION_CODE,
  RX_AREA_CODE,
  RX_REGION_CODE,
  RX_DISTRICT_CODE
FROM
  WITH_CALCULATED_FLAGS
GROUP BY
  MANDT,
  FISCPER,
  FISCVARNT,
  FISCYEAR,
  FISCPER3,
  _BIC_ZIO_SWEEK,
  _B631_S_CHRTACCT,
  _B631_S_CO_AREA,
  _BIC_ZIO_CMPCD,
  _B631_S_PROFTCTR,
  CAL_FS_RX_FLAG,
  _B631_S_COSTCNTR,
  _B631_S_FUNCAREA,
  _BIC_ZIO_VER,
  _BIC_ZIO_SAUDT,
  _B631_S_GL_ACCT,
  _BIC_ZWWPC_PA1,
  _BIC_ZWWSC_PA1,
  CURRENCY,
  REP_MKT_CODE,
  REP_MKT_DESC,
  EMERG_MKT_IND,
  FS_COMP_WK,
  RX_COMP_WK,
  CAL_COMP_FLAG,
  DIVISION_CODE,
  DIVISION_DESC,
  AREA_CODE,
  AREA_DESC,
  REGION_CODE,
  REGION_DESC,
  DISTRICT_CODE,
  DISTRICT_DESC,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  ZRWSTRTDATE,
  ZRWENDDATE,
  CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
  PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT,
  FS_OPEN_DAT,
  RX_OPEN_DAT,
  CAL_WEEK,
  STRNUM,
  RX_DIVISION_CODE,
  RX_AREA_CODE,
  RX_REGION_CODE,
  RX_DISTRICT_CODE;

-- =====================================================================
-- END OF CONSOLIDATED SQL
